trust_root.repository_test_mode: explicit isolated roots allowed only from a non-installed launcher path

claim.output: one opaque ticket lease record; available when MAX_CONCURRENT_TICKETS is 2 through 6

release-expired.output: exact expired ticket lease release confirmation; live, mismatched, malformed, or active leases remain closed

linear-sync.authority: one scheduled full-board reconciliation for the selected production project
linear-sync.security: fresh environment with only HOME, PATH, TMPDIR, and FACTORY_ROOT; credentials are resolved by the helper from owner-local stores

reconcile.authority: non-overlapping non-agent reconciliation claims up to four disposable cells, executes only receipt-authorized actions, persists restart-safe claims, and immediately resolves each terminal event

incident-report.authority: production-only opt-in reporting of explicitly classified Factory defects; reads sanitized controller metadata, deduplicates by stable fingerprint, and creates or comments on GitHub issues without changing lane state

watch.authority: read-only newline-delimited, sanitized operator-action projections of authenticated immutable controller events; opaque cursors are bound to the exact project event stream

ticket-control.authority: records one exact passport-bound pause, explicitly reconstructs that ticket without scanning historical passports, plans and applies one exact semantic-round authorization child, or plans and applies one operator-selected authenticated duplicate Reviewer void child

qualification.authority: immutable exact reduction of an acyclic three-ticket ordered cohort or four-ticket concurrent cohort across authenticated passports, source-to-candidate migration, cumulative and candidate-only charges, controller history, protected checks, and GitHub merge truth

dispatch-plan.authority: deprecated Contract 1.8 compatibility alias for one deterministic reconciliation; it may not spawn an agentic dispatcher

state-machine.authority: sole transition resolver; materializes legal ticket state, calls next-stage once, and issues an owner-only one-use receipt bound to the exact head, tree, evidence, route, passport, Factory release, and certified product origin

emergency-admit.authority: one hash-approved, issue-bound, expiring fallback consumption of the unchanged deterministic pre-provider role receipt; every budget, lease, provider, publication, approval, merge, and terminal gate remains ordinary and mandatory

passport.authority: authenticated owner-only lane-neutral role, charge, release, base, transition, and publication continuity

publication.authority: exactly one short-lived merge authority ordered by priority, publication_ready_at, then ticket ID; open PR validation remains concurrent

publication-repair.authority: after one consumed same-head transient rerun, disables auto-merge, reopens only the classified Builder or Test-author role, and requires fresh Reviewer and Narrator evidence

ci-rerun.authority: one rerun per exact head only for one completed application-test failure while all policy, security, configuration, control-plane, and immutability checks are green

ticket-pr.authority: create or reuse one exact open ticket PR at the Reviewer boundary, validate it at Narrator and Contract 1.8 publication boundaries against the unchanged transition receipt and reviewed lineage, and require exact-head GitHub checks; never approve or merge

models.output: deterministic JSON emitted directly by the selected release model-control helper

output_schemas.pin-batch: model-pin-batch/v1 containing one to four exact ticket-model-route-plan/v1 pin results
output_schemas.pin: ticket-model-route-plan/v1 plus commit_created, commit_sha, and pin_hash
output_schemas.migrate-plan: compact ticket-model-route-migration-preview/v1; --include-journal adds the complete authenticated candidate
output_schemas.fallback-auto: ticket-model-route-journal/v2 plus qualification-bound handoff commit metadata

models.json_marker: required as the final launcher argument and stripped before helper invocation

state.ticket_route_plan: <ticket-worktree>/factory/route-plans/<T-NNN>.json (v1 immutable plan or v2 append-only journal)
state.isolation: active profiles and temporary overrides are selected only from the validated launcher project

pin_transaction.first_pin: validate a clean exact ticket branch and certified origin, record a missing Kit-SHA with the shared validated helper, generate the route plan, stage both paths, create exactly one Software Factory commit, and push HEAD to the exact ticket branch
pin_transaction.existing_pin: an exact committed Kit-SHA and route plan is validated, pushed to the exact ticket branch, and returned without a new commit
pin_transaction.pre_commit_failure: restore the ticket and route-plan paths and leave no staged-only state

pin workdir uses the launcher's exact physical ticket worktree validation
fallback uses a dedicated exact-worktree validator that permits only helper-validated partial changes
fallback consumes one exact unexpired Linear operator approval bound to its preview hash

only pin receives the receipt-bound FACTORY_CERTIFIED_PRODUCT_ORIGIN
task-bearing adapters do not inherit FACTORY_MODEL_STATE_ROOT or FACTORY_PROJECT

operator-snapshot.security: read-only, fixed selected project, no caller paths

envelope.security: exact preview hash, bounded expiring override, fixed product/global paths

attempt.security: exact run process identity, preview CAS, product-local signal, conservative post-GO accounting

next-stage.contract_1_3_terminal_action: COMPLETE means a valid attested Done ticket is present on protected main; release the matching dispatcher lease

ticket-state.output: the committed ticket state after applying the ignored operator overlay, requested transition, Contract 1.7 Reviewer reconciliation, or protected qualification backlog return

refresh non-force merges the exact protected main tip, retires stale bundle and approval evidence, and requires fresh review and narration
bundle binds every successful role-run manifest to its exact committed six-role route-plan tuple, blob, digest, policy hash, and kit SHA

emergency-apply requires the exact plan hash and reuses the ordinary protected closeout PR and ledger projection without synthesizing approval evidence
a valid existing closeout commit is retryable without another projection or commit
all pushes use the certification receipt product origin

helper_environment.FACTORY_OPERATOR_MAP: sealed qualification operator overlay path: owner-local lane state for isolated qualification or the canonical live map for takeover
helper_environment.FACTORY_QUALIFICATION_MANIFEST: sealed qualification manifest path supplied only by a qualification launcher
helper_environment.FACTORY_QUALIFICATION_FALLBACK_READINESS: qualification receipt-bound native fallback readiness digest
helper_environment.FACTORY_CERTIFIED_PRODUCT_ORIGIN: contract 1.2+ certification receipt product_origin; consumed by trusted write helpers and never exposed to adapters
helper_environment.FACTORY_DISPATCH_LEASE_ID: validated optional ticket lease supplied by the dispatcher
helper_environment.FACTORY_AUTHENTICATED_ROLE_EVIDENCE: Contract 1.8 owner-only ephemeral completed-role sequence created only by the state machine for its next-stage child
helper_environment.FACTORY_PROVIDER_ACTIVATION: fixed owner-local activation gate: Contract 1.6 API-only v1; Contract 1.7/1.8 API v1 or subscription-CLI v2
helper_environment.FACTORY_CLI_RUNTIME_ROOT: fixed Contract 1.7+ owner-local per-attempt subscription CLI runtime directory
helper_environment.FACTORY_CURSOR_ACCOUNT_DB: fixed machine-local owner-only Cursor account-route admission database shared by production and qualification
helper_environment.FACTORY_PROVIDER_BROKER_URL: fixed Contract 1.6 loopback TLS broker endpoint

GH_TOKEN.assignment: exactly one optional GH_TOKEN assignment parsed as data
GH_TOKEN.file_policy: owner-owned regular non-symlink file with mode 0600

active_record.contract_1_2_receipt_binding: contracts 1.2 and 1.3 use receipt_id to select an owner-only mode-0600 receipt whose project, kit SHA/tree, product path/tree, contract, and product origin bind trusted writes
active_record.selection: resolved and validated once per invocation

launcher.managed_path_policy: reject every symlink component before physical resolution

concurrency.capacity_scope: generation-wide admission and provider budget with up to four disposable per-ticket execution cells
concurrency.ticket_identity: product, ticket ID, branch, and authenticated passport; never a lane, cell, or filesystem path
concurrency.parallel_execution_gate: the retained product-wide provider lock serializes every non-activated route; an exact owner-activated Contract 1.6 API route or Contract 1.7/1.8 API/subscription-CLI route may use transactional parallel admission
concurrency.stale_policy: never reassigned automatically; recover explicitly through factory-kit under maintenance after active-run validation

activation_schemas.nysa.software-factory.provider-activatio: Contract 1.6 or 1.7 API route bound to broker protocol and path
Contract 1.7 or 1.8 subscription CLI route bound to exact adapter, model, provider family, account route, and provider-policy SHA-256

provider_execution.activation_gate: disabled unless the owner-only canonical activation matches the active contract, selected route identity, and exact provider-policy digest; invalid or absent activation retains serialized execution only for legacy or single-ticket routes, while Contract 1.8 multi-ticket execution refuses admission
provider_execution.legacy_contracts: contracts 1.0.0 through 1.5.0 retain interval-wide serialized provider execution
provider_execution.contract_1_6_compatibility: Contract 1.6 accepts only activation v1 and retains native subscription/Cursor CLI serialization

coordinator.financial_accounting: integer micro-USD machine-day, product-day, and ticket caps count active reservations plus terminal charges in the admission transaction
coordinator.unknown_outcome: retain the full reservation and provider slot for explicit reconciliation

credential_broker.transport: host-loopback TLS endpoint reachable only by the trusted runtime; plaintext is restricted to explicit loopback-only tests
credential_broker.proxy_policy: exact owner-configured HTTPS origin and path, exact token-bound model, bounded JSON request, no redirects, and host-side credential substitution
credential_broker.worker_exposure: the trusted runtime consumes the attempt token and relays only the bounded provider result into a networkless worker; tokens and credentials never enter the container
credential_broker.revocation: terminalization revokes the attempt token; expiry, revocation, or request exhaustion fails closed
credential_broker.reporting: token hashes and raw provider credentials are never returned by status

worker.source_transport: sanitized copy-in with no host Git metadata, control state, sibling worktrees, credentials, process namespace, or container socket
worker.artifact_transport: size-bounded copy-out bound to the immutable worker identity
worker.container: ephemeral unprivileged digest-pinned image with read-only root, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, PID/CPU/memory limits, and attempt-local scratch
worker.network: none; provider egress occurs only in the trusted host runtime through the configured credential broker

controller.reconciliation_authority: non-agent one-shot controller invokes state-machine receipts; Cursor roles execute assigned work and never choose the next state
controller.schedule: launchd non-overlapping reconciliation every 15 seconds plus immediate terminal-event wakeup
controller.apply_rule: revalidate the exact ticket branch and base SHA, validate protected paths and artifact identity in a temporary index, then apply and commit under a per-ticket lock

subscription_cli.identity_binding: activation adapter, model, provider family, and account route must exactly match the frozen selected route; activation policy_sha256 must equal the canonical provider policy digest
subscription_cli.admission: reuse the Contract 1.6 transactional coordinator; lane lifecycle and accounting remain isolated, while task-bearing Cursor starts additionally hold one machine-local account-route lease before GO through process-group drainage
subscription_cli.account_limits: Contract 1.8 policy covers every enabled Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex account route at ticket capacity; Cursor production and qualification lanes sharing an account route must agree on limits and share aggregate concurrency/start admission, with production priority for the final slot
subscription_cli.runtime_root: ~/.factory/cli-runtimes contains owner-only attempt homes and is independent of tickets, cells, and qualification lanes
subscription_cli.certification_binding: receipt and activation journal bind the policy digest, ticket capacity, covered routes and adapters, Factory SHA/tree, and runtime-root identity
subscription_cli.git_authority: provider roles may commit locally but cannot push; the trusted host wrapper validates remote durability and owns every push

recovery.cancellation: persist request before signaling; release capacity only after container removal is proven
recovery.unknown_outcome: post-GO missing or unobservable workers retain reservation and slot for explicit reconciliation
recovery.rollback: refuse while attempts, legacy intervals, broker tokens, or live/unknown workers remain; preserve activation configuration as disabled evidence

provider_execution.legacy_barrier: no isolated-v1 or cli-concurrent-v1 admission while any legacy provider interval is active, and no legacy provider interval starts while coordinated attempts are active
provider_execution.serialized_fallback: missing, disabled, malformed, identity-mismatched, or policy-mismatched activation never enables concurrency; Contract 1.6, older contracts, and explicit single-ticket execution remain serialized, while Contract 1.8 multi-ticket execution refuses instead of falling back

controller.label: com.factory.controller.<project>
controller.scope: one registered product; non-overlapping one-shot reconciliation

incident_reporter.label: com.factory.incident-reporter.<project>
incident_reporter.scope: one explicitly opted-in production project and one configured GitHub issue repository

linear_sync.label: com.factory.linear-sync.<project>
linear_sync.scope: one explicitly enabled or disabled registered production product through the stable launcher

security.profile_credential_source: mode-0600 $HERMES_FACTORY_PROFILE/.env parsed as data and never sourced
public_redaction: quoted, JSON, multiline, and multi-token sensitive-key values
